subject: Installation errors under R 2.8 / Mac OS X

messages.author: 67dd8164f9bfa181
messages.subject: Installation errors under R 2.8 / Mac OS X
parts:
Hi,

while updating to R 2.8, I ran into (up to now) 2 erors:

1. matrixstats doesn't load, since it references to R 2.7:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
unable to load shared library '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/
Resources/library/matrixStats/libs/i386/matrixStats.so':
dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/library/matrixStats/
libs/i386/matrixStats.so, 6): Library not loaded: /Library/Frameworks/
R.framework/Versions/2.7/Resources/lib/libR.dylib
Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/library/
matrixStats/libs/i386/matrixStats.so
Reason: image not found

I tried to change the 2.7 to 2.8 (in matrixStats.so). At least seems
to load ...

2. EBImage is broken due to a missing dependency:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
unable to load shared library '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/
Resources/library/EBImage/libs/i386/EBImage.so':
dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/library/EBImage/
libs/i386/EBImage.so, 6): Library not loaded: /usr/local/lib/libgtk-
x11-2.0.0.dylib
Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/library/
EBImage/libs/i386/EBImage.so
Reason: image not found

Apparently this is due to the new GTK+ installer (information from:

http://groups.google.com/group/ggobi/browse_thread/thread/1715ee840e861f32

I have no workaround for that ...

Help & comments appreciated!

Best,

Michael.

Update: EBImage did install from source.

Michael.
